scope: Instrumented isolated Chromium, temporary context, no personal cookies. Only the initial document and same-origin scripts are served through pinned HTTPS. New navigations and media are intercepted and aborted. Minimal response headers may differ from a normal browser. No video, raw source, complete URLs, paths, query parameters or trace files are published. This is not a playback test.
additional_scope: Contact only the exact observed same-path HTTPS destination on the explicit five-host allowlist and same-run dmca list. Parse its HTML and packed data without executing destination scripts. Resolve only bounded literal strings, concatenations and uniquely initialized visible identifiers before use. Select one unambiguous static JW HLS source and pass it to existing pinned-HTTPS playlist verification. Playlist hosts come from that configuration and playlist variants; public DNS and TLS checks remain. No redirects, linked destination scripts, keys, segments or video requested. Signed URLs stay private.

routing_assignment_capture.note: Observed source data; destination contact additionally requires the explicit diagnostic allowlist and same-run membership. Not evidence of playback.

routing_capture_scope: AST-based value observation at named main/dmca/rules initializers and assignments, including local scopes. Original values returned unchanged. No source publication.
